description:
The memory-first coding agent

Letta Code is a memory-first coding harness, designed for long-lived agents that can learn from experience.
Instead of working in independent sessions, you work with a persisted agent whose memory is portable across models (Claude, GPT, Gemini, GLM, Kimi, and more).
What's Changed
- fix(a2a): discover agents as the current sender [LET-12546] by @carenthomas in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4483
- test(ci): retry unaccepted teleport fixture requests by @cpacker in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4487
- fix(subagents): terminate stopped agent process trees by @cpacker in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4497
- feat(ci): add expert escalation after code review by @carenthomas in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4501
- fix(memfs): skip attached sync on local backend by @cpacker in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4504
- chore(ci): remove CODEOWNERS by @cpacker in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4505
- test(ci): allow model configuration the same time as inference by @cpacker in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4460
- test(listener): keep ownership tests independent of Cloud by @cpacker in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4510
- fix(channels): restart gateway after unexpected exits by @just-cameron in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4478
